evidence: Plan and cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM), X-ray diffraction and atomic force microscopy have been used to understand the nature of the films. X-ray and electron diffraction showed that a polycrystalline, epitaxial anatase film was produced. Roughness measurement using atomic force microscopy showed that the epitaxial anatase films were quite smooth, in comparison to equivalent non-aligned films grown on silicon. Ellipsometric measurement, which obtains data from a much larger area of the film, gave the film thickness as 86nm and a corresponding growth rate of 0.043nm/cycle.
